infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: AgriTrack Liberia requires camera access for farm photography and QR code traceability scanning.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: AgriTrack Liberia requires location permissions to record precise GPS coordinates for farm boundaries and field visits.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: AgriTrack Liberia needs photo library access to upload farm, crop, and inspection evidence photos.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow AgriTrack Liberia to use camera for farm and quality inspection photography.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow AgriTrack Liberia to capture farm GPS coordinates.
